children: CXApp’s third-quarter revenue rose 169.7% year over year, while its net loss was broadly unchanged. EngineRoom contributed new subscription, managed advertising and growth marketing advisory revenue; the acquisition also shifted the mix toward services with higher direct delivery costs, reducing gross margin.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net Loss”.
: The acquired business contributed $2.1M of revenue in the quarter, including managed advertising and growth marketing advisory services.
: Managed advertising and growth marketing advisory contributed $1.6M in the quarter; software, license and maintenance revenue declined $209K.
: Margin fell to 53.88% from 88.96%, primarily reflecting EngineRoom services’ higher direct-cost profile.
: Expenses were $4.8M, down $33K year over year, as lower research and development costs offset increases in other categories.
